description: King County Metro - Water Taxi Routes 773/775 is a dataset listed in King County open data portal (data.kingcounty.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by King County. Route 773 provides scheduled service (see schedules) between the Alaska Junction and Seacrest Park. Route 775 provides scheduled service (see schedules) between Admiral Junction, Alki, and Seacrest Park. Both routes serving all regular bus stops along the route. For more information, call Metro’s Rider Information at 206-553-3000 or check schedules at the transit center. Coverage: King County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Transportation & Roads. Its tags are water taxi, king county metro. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: King County. The portal shows 2023-01-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-kingcounty-gov-portal.
